additional_info.subject: ID0448483-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP/S8170003982] Change configuration CRM:02699000239
additional_info.body:
Hello Cenoiu, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
Unfortunately, this is how the charger is supposed to work. If you have authentication enabled, to avoid that any person stops the session (on a whim or similar), we always require the customer to present his RFID/authentication method to stop the session.
Please let me know if there is anything else you need.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0448483-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP/S8170003982] Change configuration CRM:02699000239
additional_info.body:
Hello Cenoiu, good morning.
I see that Johannes already tried to help you but the configuration is missing the rest of the line:
I tested yesterday in our lab and the only difference between this being enabled and disabled is only when the authentication is required to be presented.
If this is disabled, anyone can check the current charging session but to cancel it, it needs to be present the RFID
If this is enabled, you need to present the RFID to check the current charging session but don't need to present it again to cancel it.
Please let me know if this has answered to your needs.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
